projects.taglineZh: 卢萨卡地标级独栋住区 · 现房热销中。
projects.taglineEn: Lusaka's landmark detached-villa community · selling now.
projects.propertyTypeZh: 高端独栋别墅 · 4 卧 / 5 卧
projects.descriptionZh:
「皇冠」是 ROOFY 集团母公司在 Kabulonga 核心地段打造的旗舰住宅项目，48 套独栋别墅围合而立，以现代殖民地风格的立面、超大客厅采光与全装修标准，重新定义卢萨卡高端住宅的体验上限。

项目自 2024 年开盘以来持续保持高去化率，现房热销中。同区内罕见地配置了独立会所、围合泳池与 24 小时安保闭环，满足 expat 家庭与本地高净值人群的全部使用场景。
projects.descriptionEn:
Crown is ROOFY parent group's flagship residential development in the heart of Kabulonga: 48 detached villas with modern colonial facades, oversized day-lit living rooms and full-fit-out standards — resetting the ceiling for high-end residential living in Lusaka.

Launched in 2024 and selling at a strong absorption rate; units are move-in ready. The development includes a private clubhouse, an enclosed pool and a 24-hour secured perimeter — covering the full demand profile from expat families to local HNW households.

keyFeatures.zh: 全屋精装交付（含中央空调与品牌厨房）
keyFeatures.en: Full fit-out delivery (central AC, branded kitchen)

keyFeatures.zh: 围合式社区 · 闭环 24 小时安保
keyFeatures.en: Gated community with 24-hour secured perimeter

keyFeatures.zh: 独立会所 + 室外泳池 + 健身室
keyFeatures.en: Private clubhouse, outdoor pool and gym

keyFeatures.zh: Kabulonga 核心地段 · 学区与商业圈零距离
keyFeatures.en: Heart of Kabulonga · adjacent schools and retail

keyFeatures.zh: 面向中赞两地买家 · 提供长期租约方案
keyFeatures.en: Open to Chinese and Zambian buyers · long-term leasehold available

projects.taglineZh: 首期已交付 · 卢萨卡新生代家庭的优选。
projects.taglineEn: First phase delivered · the rising-family residence of choice in Lusaka.
projects.propertyTypeZh: 联排别墅 · 3 卧 / 4 卧
projects.descriptionZh:
「奇迹」位于 Ibex Hill 边缘，是集团交付完成度最高的代表作之一。96 套联排别墅以紧凑而高效的户型设计，承接卢萨卡新生代家庭的「第一套自置住宅」需求——首批购房者中超过 60% 为本地中产家庭，剩余为 expat 与海外华人投资人。

项目自 2022 年开盘到 2025 年全部交付，期间维持了零延期记录，是赞比亚本土少有的「兑现承诺」型住宅项目。
projects.descriptionEn:
Miracle sits at the edge of Ibex Hill — the group's most delivery-complete project to date. 96 townhouses with efficient, compact floorplans, sized for Lusaka's emerging family demographic looking for their first owned home. Over 60% of first-phase buyers were local middle-class families; the remainder split between expats and overseas Chinese investors.

Launched 2022, fully delivered by 2025 with a zero-delay record — a rare commitment-kept residential project in the Zambian market.

keyFeatures.zh: 全部 96 套已交付 · 入住率 ≥ 85%
keyFeatures.en: All 96 units delivered · 85%+ occupancy

keyFeatures.zh: 高性价比户型（紧凑而完整的三/四卧设计）
keyFeatures.en: Compact, complete 3/4-bed floorplans

keyFeatures.zh: 邻近 Ibex Hill 学区与生活配套
keyFeatures.en: Adjacent to Ibex Hill schools and amenities

keyFeatures.zh: 首批本地家庭客户超 60%
keyFeatures.en: 60%+ first-phase buyers are local families

keyFeatures.zh: 现房可买可租 · 投资人租赁回报率 7-9%
keyFeatures.en: Available for purchase or rental · investor rental yield 7-9%

projects.taglineZh: 新一代「慢生活」社区 · 建设中，2027 年 Q2 交付。
projects.taglineEn: A new-generation slow-living community · under construction, delivering 2027 Q2.
projects.propertyTypeZh: 低密度独栋别墅 · 4 卧 / 5 卧
projects.descriptionZh:
「静居」是集团对「慢生活」理念的一次完整诠释——位于 Roma 区低密度地块上的 32 套独栋别墅，单户占地面积超 1500 平方米，强调建筑与原生植被的共生关系。

项目目前处于建设期，2027 年 Q2 交付。首期开盘的 12 套面向预约客户，剩余 20 套将于 2026 年下半年公开发售。
projects.descriptionEn:
Serene is the group's full expression of the slow-living concept — 32 detached villas on a low-density parcel in Roma, with single-plot footprints exceeding 1,500 sqm. The design emphasises the symbiosis of architecture and existing vegetation.

Project is currently under construction, delivering 2027 Q2. The first 12 units are reserved for waitlist clients; the remaining 20 release publicly in H2 2026.

keyFeatures.zh: 低密度 · 单户占地 1,500+ 平米
keyFeatures.en: Low density · 1,500+ sqm per plot

keyFeatures.zh: 原生植被保护率 ≥ 60%
keyFeatures.en: 60%+ native vegetation preservation

keyFeatures.zh: 智能家居全屋集成（小米 / Aqara）
keyFeatures.en: Whole-house smart home (Xiaomi / Aqara)

keyFeatures.zh: 首期 12 套预约客户优先 · 剩余 20 套 H2 2026 公开发售
keyFeatures.en: First 12 units waitlist-priority; 20 more public sale H2 2026

keyFeatures.zh: Roma 区核心 · 安静而通达
keyFeatures.en: Heart of Roma · quiet yet connected

projects.taglineZh: 卢萨卡 CBD 旁的天际线公寓 · 建设中，2028 年开盘。
projects.taglineEn: Skyline apartments next to Lusaka CBD · under construction, opening 2028.
projects.propertyTypeZh: 高层精装公寓 · 1 卧 / 2 卧 / 3 卧
projects.descriptionZh:
「荣耀」是集团首次进入卢萨卡 CBD 周边高层住宅市场的代表项目，240 套精装公寓覆盖 1 / 2 / 3 卧多户型，主力面向年轻专业人士、外派员工与短期投资人。

项目在 Cathedral Hill 拔地而起，景观视野直接覆盖 Independence Avenue、Lusaka Showgrounds 与机场方向。预计 2028 年全期交付，2026 年开放预约。
projects.descriptionEn:
Honor is the group's first move into Lusaka's CBD-fringe high-rise residential market — 240 furnished apartments across 1/2/3-bed layouts, designed for young professionals, expat employees and short-stay investors.

Rising on Cathedral Hill with sightlines across Independence Avenue, the Lusaka Showgrounds and the airport corridor. Full delivery 2028; reservations open 2026.

keyFeatures.zh: 240 套精装公寓 · 1/2/3 卧多户型
keyFeatures.en: 240 furnished apartments · 1/2/3-bed mix

keyFeatures.zh: 高层视野直达 CBD 与机场方向
keyFeatures.en: Skyline views across CBD and airport corridor

keyFeatures.zh: 面向年轻专业人士与短租投资人
keyFeatures.en: Targeted at young professionals and short-stay investors

keyFeatures.zh: 底商配套：餐饮、便利店、共享办公
keyFeatures.en: Ground-floor retail: F&B, convenience, co-working

keyFeatures.zh: 2026 开放预约 · 2028 全期交付
keyFeatures.en: Reservations open 2026 · full delivery 2028
